key_terms.بَارِدٍ: Cool (referring to relief or ease, opposite of heat)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says the fire of Hell is neither cool nor agreeable?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir highlights the total absence of respite for the disbelievers, contrasting with the 'coolness of the eyes' (coolness of delight) granted to the righteous in Paradise. The negation of both 'barid' (coolness/relief) and 'karim' (generosity/pleasantness) underscores a state of absolute deprivation and unmitigated torment, serving as a thematic counterpoint to the divine generosity bestowed upon the faithful.
